decisions.reason: A pipe cleaning box for sewers is a niche municipal infrastructure product with long sales cycles, so a young metal fabricator would keep it after only one year.
Public waste bins fit the firm's municipal street-furniture range and use its existing fabrication capabilities, so keeping them costs little.
Ground sleeves for posts are a core catalog item that complements the bins and other street fixtures, so they will likely stay.
Cast iron ground sleeves are a variant within the ground sleeve line that serves specific customer demand at low marginal cost.
Steel ground sleeves round out the sleeve range with an option made in-house, so the firm would keep them in the portfolio.
